title: A framework exceeding 2,000 leaf requirements is truncated with a visible warning, not a silent partial dataset
description: listRequirements enforces MAX_LIMIT=2000 (chosen to cover NIST SP 800-53's 1,189 controls with headroom). FrameworkComplianceMap sets `truncated` when reqRes.pagination.total exceeds the returned count and shows a warning banner rather than silently under-reporting coverage totals.
preconditions: A test framework is seeded with 2,500 leaf requirements
steps: Activate the oversized framework for a project
expectedResult: A warning banner reads 'This framework has more than 2,000 controls. Only the first 2,000 are shown — coverage totals may be incomplete.' Page remains responsive (no unbounded DOM render of all 2,500 rows at once).

title: CSV export fetches per-control asset detail in batches of 6, not as one unbounded fan-out
description: exportCSV() fetches getRequirementAssets for every control-with-assets in parallel batches of BATCH=6, and warns the user first if more than 50 controls are being exported ('Preparing export… This may take a moment.'). Verifies large exports don't fire hundreds of simultaneous requests.
preconditions: A framework has 120 controls, all with at least one attached asset
steps: Clear all filters (full-framework export) and click 'Export CSV'
Observe network activity and the info toast
expectedResult: An info toast appears warning about fetching resource details for 120 controls. Network panel shows requests to getRequirementAssets going out in waves of at most 6 concurrent calls, not all 120 at once.

title: Repeated frameworks-catalog loads within the 1-hour window read the cached ClientComplianceSummary in O(1) instead of recomputing live aggregation
description: getFrameworkList/getProjectSummary check ClientComplianceSummary.lastRefreshedAt first; if under the 1-hour STALE_THRESHOLD_MS, they return the cached doc directly instead of re-aggregating every ClientRequirement/ClientControl for the project. This keeps repeat page loads for large frameworks fast.
preconditions: A project's ClientComplianceSummary was refreshed less than 1 hour ago
steps: Load /grc-framework twice in a row within a few minutes, measuring the response time of GET /compliance-frameworks/projects/:projectId/compliance/frameworks each time
expectedResult: Both calls return quickly and with identical coverage figures (served from the cached summary doc) — no live re-aggregation query pattern appears in the second call's timing/logs while the cache is fresh.
